item.title: Correction · 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St): OpenAI at 1515 3rd St is now shown as announced (an October 2023 lease report) rather than open since December 2024, because the December 2024 date is only a business-registration start. Uber is shown as closed at 1515 because its FY2025 annual report gives 1725 3rd St and the building was reported leased to OpenAI in 2023; the earlier FY2022 filing is what had made it look open. The completion milestone is now 2021 (Assessor), with ArchDaily's 2022 noted, instead of June 2021; the pile-driver milestone links its SocketSite post; and the unsourced 'Uber Mission Bay 2' name was dropped from the notes.
item.description: OpenAI at 1515 3rd St is now shown as announced (an October 2023 lease report) rather than open since December 2024, because the December 2024 date is only a business-registration start. Uber is shown as closed at 1515 because its FY2025 annual report gives 1725 3rd St and the building was reported leased to OpenAI in 2023; the earlier FY2022 filing is what had made it look open. The completion milestone is now 2021 (Assessor), with ArchDaily's 2022 noted, instead of June 2021; the pile-driver milestone links its SocketSite post; and the unsourced 'Uber Mission Bay 2' name was dropped from the notes. Source: SF Standard, 2023-10-27 (https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis); Uber Technologies, FY2025 annual report (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1543151/000154315126000015/uber-20251231.htm); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8721029 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721029); ArchDaily (https://www.archdaily.com/1006339/uber-headquarters-shop-architects); SocketSite, 2016-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2016/09/uber-about-to-start-building-new-san-francisco-hq.html).

item.title: Added · 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St): Uber's annual report for FY2022 gave 1515 3rd Street, San Francisco, as its principal executive offices; its FY2025 annual report gives 1725 3rd Street. Reports in October 2023 have OpenAI leasing 1515 3rd St, so Uber is now shown as no longer at 1515.

item.title: Added · 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St): SF Standard (October 27, 2023) reported OpenAI is leasing two buildings from Uber's Mission Bay headquarters, 1455 and 1515 Third St. DataSF Registered Business Locations shows an OpenAI registration at 1515 3rd St with a location start date of 2024-12-09, which is a registration date, not an opening date, so no opening date is given.
